title: Almost every parallel line meets a Lebesgue-null set in a null set
statement: Let n >= 0, let N be a subset of R^n with Lebesgue (outer) measure L^n(N) = 0 (N need not be measurable), and let x, h ∈ R^n. Then for L^n-almost every w ∈ R^n, the set {t ∈ R : x + w + t h ∈ N} has one-dimensional Lebesgue (outer) measure 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : Set (Rn n)), volume N = 0 → ∀ (x h : Rn n), ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), volume {t : ℝ | x + w + t • h ∈ N} = 0
